Looking at the code, I can see the performance regression. The refactoring added `allocate_batch_scratch` and `free_batch_scratch` calls in `solve.cu`, which perform 2048 individual `cudaMalloc` and `cudaFree` operations per decode call. These scratch buffers are never actually used by the kernel - they're allocated and immediately freed without being passed to the kernel at all.
